title: Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs Invoicing Frequency, Payment Terms and Arrears Figures by Tier
content:
Accounts receivable note. Each tier of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs is invoiced and collected on the figures below.

| Tier | Invoicing frequency of the program price | Days from invoice date to due date (calendar days) | Late fee on an overdue invoice per month (percent per month) | Days past due after which deliveries and visits stop (calendar days) | Fee charged when a suspended or lapsed program is restarted (USD) | Days after the program year end within which a lapsed program restarts without a fresh survey (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter Supply Program | Annual | 30 | 1.5 | 45 | 0 | 30 |
| Managed Filtration Program | Annual | 30 | 1.5 | 45 | 85 | 30 |
| Coil Hygiene Program | Quarterly | 30 | 1.5 | 45 | 125 | 45 |
| Air Quality Monitoring Program | Quarterly | 30 | 1.5 | 30 | 225 | 45 |
| UV & Purification Service Program | Monthly | 30 | 1.25 | 30 | 350 | 60 |
| Certified Indoor Air Quality Program | Monthly | 45 | 1.0 | 30 | 600 | 90 |

**Frequency.** Annual invoicing raises one program price invoice per program year; quarterly invoicing raises four; monthly invoicing raises twelve. The Filter Supply Program and the Managed Filtration Program are invoiced annually, the Coil Hygiene Program and the Air Quality Monitoring Program quarterly, the UV & Purification Service Program and the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program monthly.

**Payment terms.** Five tiers carry 30-day terms; the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program alone carries 45-day terms.

**Late fee rate.** The rate is a percentage of the overdue invoice for each month it stays unpaid: 1.5 percent per month at the four lower tiers, 1.25 percent per month at the UV & Purification Service Program, 1.0 percent per month at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program.

**Reinstatement fee.** The Filter Supply Program restarts at no fee; every other tier carries the fee in its row, from 85 USD at the Managed Filtration Program to 600 USD at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program.

**Restart window.** The window is 30 days at the two lowest tiers, 45 days at the Coil Hygiene Program and the Air Quality Monitoring Program, 60 days at the UV & Purification Service Program and 90 days at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program.
